scope: Bounded transfer of explicit rendered page-region crops; known development sources, not held-out acceptance

contract_control.requests: pages 1-3, displayed PDFUserSpace left40 top40 right80 bottom80
contract_control.samples: pixel (5,20) left and (35,20) right, identical to the existing JVM upstream-crop checker

gates.page2_alpha0_5: left red >= 250, green and blue in [120,135]
gates.page3_half_clip: left red >= 245, green and blue <= 10; right every channel >= 250

magazine.partition_options: PdfOptions.defaults() ORIENTED_LINES, imageClipBounds, imageGroupContext; curved-clip classification compares curvedClipEnvelopes on/off
magazine.selection: union of (a) every image occurrence with a nonempty pdf_image_group_context and (b) every occurrence whose clip bounds change when curvedClipEnvelopes is selected; deduplicated by occurrence index; no other region
magazine.expected_population: 5 group-context occurrences (pages 8/11/20) and 11 curved-clip occurrences (page 8), as documented; any difference is recorded, not tuned away
magazine.request: displayed axis-aligned box of each occurrence's PDFUserSpace coordinates points
magazine.single_call: all selected requests in one render call with default limits except maxRequests raised only if the population exceeds 64
measurements: success or typed failure per request
crop and page raster dimensions, pixel origin, clipped flag
crop pixel SHA-256 and mean RGB
independent Poppler pdftoppm render of the same page at the same DPI and the same pixel rectangle (-x -y -W -H)
mean absolute per-channel difference between DocWeave/PDFBox and Poppler crops
magazine.independent_agreement_tolerance: mean absolute per-channel difference <= 12 (0-255 scale) per crop, declared before measurement; disagreements are retained and reported, not used to tune anything
magazine.source_regressions: 94 occurrences; unchanged source PNG hashes for every occurrence before and after crop rendering; existing 4 affine references via VerifySourceImageCornerMaps default and --group-context; 18-/24-slot qualified figures default and --group-context
